data.text/markdown:
Cleaning notebook

notebook of data cleaning applied as an example to a static data-file: Power Search export governor_all_donations_61526.csv. (note that raw data dumps, for other races / in bulk, will be pulled directly from cal-access)

data.text/html: 186,417 rows × 22 columns

data.text/markdown: Data Cleaning

1. Drop the export footer rows

  • drop all obs that lack a Recipient Committee ID (e.g., drops footer rows)

data.text/html: Dropped 6 footer rows; 186,411 contribution rows remain.

data.text/markdown:
2. Convert types

  • Amount → float
  • Start Date / End Date → datetime
  • Cycle → integer year

data.text/html: Total contributions: $299,873,355

data.text/markdown:
3. Text normalization

Two cleanups on the string columns:
  1. Strip stray leading/trailing whitespace from every text column.
  2. Unify missing-value placeholders in Employer / Occupation — e.g., collapse "n/a", "N/A", "na", "none" into the same NA value. Preserve real values like Retired and Not Employed are left untouched.

data.text/html:
Employer — before
Employer — after

data.text/markdown:
4. Inspect transaction types

Note that Power Search is more granular than Cal-Access (e.g., Power Search has late contribution/loan/monetary/non-monetary; Cal-Access only has late monetary contribution/non-monetary)

data.text/markdown:
5. Date sanity check

Contributions should fall within the 2025–2026 cycle. Flag any row dated in the future so it can be reviewed — usually a data-entry typo in the filing

data.text/html: 1 row(s) dated after 2026-06-16:

data.text/markdown:
6. Potential duplicate contributions

Rows identical on date + amount + contributor + committee + type are likely the same gift reported twice (re-filed amendments, overlapping exports). They are only candidates — two separate $100 gifts from one donor on one day are legitimate & aren't dropped for the time being

data.text/html: 5,314 rows are exact repeats of an earlier row (10,005 rows involved in a duplicate group).
